note: Structural items that cannot be compared statically, registered explicitly (owner + reviewBy + reason). An entry here is a decision, not debt: the checker prints it as `registered` and it is not a divergence. An entry that matches no observed item is an error (delete it), and a past reviewBy is an error (re-review it). Two shapes so far: (a) an untitled baseline group whose only row text is runtime data (error/notice blocks), so no literal criterion exists by design; (b) an Android section title computed from state while the contract section is titled/criterion-based.

entries.name: <untitled: error>
entries.reason: MCPSettingsPage.swift:97 renders `Section { Text(error) }`: an untitled error block whose only row is runtime text, so no literal criterion exists.

entries.name: <untitled: notice>
entries.reason: MCPSettingsPage.swift:102 renders `Section { Text(notice) }`: an untitled notice block whose only row is runtime text.

entries.name: <untitled: errorText>
entries.reason: MCPSettingsPage.swift:257 renders `Section { Text(errorText) }`: an untitled error block whose only row is runtime text.

entries.name: <untitled: nativeConfigurationError(error)>
entries.reason: NativeConfigurationPage.swift:17 renders `Section { Label(nativeConfigurationError(error), …) }`: an untitled error block whose row is runtime text, so no literal criterion exists.

entries.name: group.title
entries.reason: The Android page supplies this group's title from host state (`group.title`); the contract section is criterion-based, so the title is runtime data and is not comparable statically. The row criterion, not the title, is the judgement.

entries.name: section.title
entries.reason: Android composes section titles from its runtime snapshot (`section.title`); the contract's titles are `本次运行`/`最近出错` and cannot be matched against runtime data.

entries.name: <untitled: folder>
entries.reason: FilesPage.swift:117 takes the group title from data (`fileGroupTitle`, the current folder). Its first row is `Label(folder)`, also data, so no literal criterion exists; the group is identified by the folder expression at runtime.

entries.name: state.groupTitle
entries.reason: Android renders the group title from state (`state.groupTitle`), which mirrors the baseline's data-as-title; there is no literal title on either side to compare.

entries.name: 删除
entries.reason: DailyBriefPage.swift:112 is a `.swipeActions` Label("删除"); Android renders the same action as a SwipeToDismissBox background label, and DailyBriefPageTest states that turning it into a visible button must fail on purpose. The action exists on both sides; only the affordance differs.

entries.name: <manual region>
entries.reason: NativeSettingsDocumentPage.swift:14 is one ungrouped region with no Section/PageSection/GroupBox/header Text; a human has to name the group before any title can be compared.

entries.name: <untitled: row(capability)>
entries.reason: PhonePermissionsPage.swift:74 iterates `PhoneCapability.allCases`; each row's label is the capability's own title, which is data from the model, not a literal in the view.

entries.name: group.title
entries.reason: PhonePermissionsPage.swift:70 iterates `PhoneCapabilityGroup.allCases` and uses `group.title` as the Section header; the titles are model data, so no literal exists. The same shape is already registered for native-configuration and session-activity.

entries.name: <untitled: empty>
entries.reason: PDSHShellPage.swift:74 is an untitled Section whose only row (PDSHShellPage.swift:75) is a ternary button (运行/运行中…); the literal the extractor reads exists in only one branch, so no stable row criterion exists. The section is the run/stop action block, judged through its actions.

entries.name: <untitled: empty>
entries.reason: The first RuntimeDetailsPage Section (ChatPage.swift:4324) opens with `runtimeRow("状态", model.isStarted ? statusValue : "已停止")`; the label's value is a ternary, so no stable first-row criterion exists. The row and the stop/restart action are judged by the actions, not by this group title.

entries.name: device.name
entries.reason: BluetoothDevicesPage.swift:154 headers each device section with the peripheral's advertised name (`header: { Text(device.name) }`); Android's SettingsSectionLabel(device.name) is the same runtime value. Untrusted advertisement text has no literal criterion on either platform.

notes.text: `完全权限` 是 Swift 的字符串比较操作数（ChatPage.swift:1395 `AccessModeWording.title(…) == "完全权限"`），不是 section 标题；该组的真实标题是两个三元分支之一，rows 就是 :1376 的菜单按钮、已作为 action 覆盖。契约里该 section 被标 `suppressed`，不给 Android 加假字面量 section。
